label: providers_home
title: Managed account boundary
body: Saved accounts, default selections and derived NEAR AI sign-in entries are separate. This panel projects daemon state.

label: providers_add
title: Add account
body: You'll sign in through the tool in Terminal. Stored in this computer's credential store.

label: providers_remove
title: Remove this account?
body: Its saved sign-in and profile are deleted from this computer.

label: providers_exposure
title: Route AI requests through NEAR AI
body: While it's on, anything else running on this computer, including other users on a shared one, can send requests charged to your accounts.

label: providers_runtime
title: Provider runtime boundary
body: Session tickets, terminal launch results, proxy startups, usage claims and configuration acknowledgments are independent daemon interfaces. These controls select abstract events.

label: providers_closed
title: No window open
body: The daemon, terminal tools and retained callbacks can continue. Open projects the window lifecycle event.
